name: CoinSpot
rootCause: On November 8, 2023, CoinSpot was exploited across two of its hot wallets, resulting in a loss of over 1,283 ETH, worth approximately $2.472 million.

descriptions.text: On November 8, 2023, CoinSpot was exploited across two of its hot wallets, resulting in a loss of over 1,283 ETH, worth approximately $2.472 million.

CoinSpot's Ethereum hot wallet was compromised on 8 November 2023, with approximately $2.4 million stolen. The attacker extracted at least 1,262 ETH and laundered assets cross-chain, converting proceeds to Bitcoin and ultimately breaking traceability. The incident was caused by a compromise of CoinSpot's Ethereum hot wallet private key, granting unauthorized access. Public reports and CertiK analysis attribute the event to probable private key compromise; the specific exposure method remains undisclosed.
